annotations.annotation_text: Fall/resurrection motif "wall" on page 437 ("Jaun's Sermon"): Tim Finnegan tumbling from his ladder, Humpty Dumpty shattering from the wall, Adam falling in Eden — all converge within Jaun (Shaun) preaching to the twenty-nine girls, the Ondt and the Gracehoper fable, departure and farewell. The comic-cosmic Fall during the Age of Men phase demands its counterpart: resurrection through the whiskey-splash of the water of life (uisce beatha).
sources: The Ballad of Tim Finnegan's Wake. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finnegan%27s_Wake
Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
Opie, Iona and Peter. The Oxford Dictionary of Nursery Rhymes. https://archive.org/details/oxforddictionary0000unse_m4u1

annotations.annotation_text: The Letter motif "envelope" on page 437 ("Jaun's Sermon"): ALP's mysterious document — scratched from the midden by Biddy Doran the Hen — represents the genesis of all writing within Jaun (Shaun) preaching to the twenty-nine girls, the Ondt and the Gracehoper fable, departure and farewell. During this Age of Men phase, the letter functions simultaneously as archaeological artifact, love note, legal deposition, and the text of Finnegans Wake itself.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Deane, Vincent, et al. The Finnegans Wake Notebooks at Buffalo. https://www.brepols.net

annotations.annotation_text: Fraternal archetype "Jaun" on page 437 ("Jaun's Sermon"): the opposing sons — Shem the Penman (introvert artist, tree, darkness) and Shaun the Post (extrovert politician, stone, light) — manifest here within Jaun (Shaun) preaching to the twenty-nine girls, the Ondt and the Gracehoper fable, departure and farewell. Their Brunonian dialectic of coinciding opposites propels the chapter's conflict during this Age of Men phase.
sources: Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
Norris, Margot. The Decentered Universe of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/decentereduniver0000norr
Gordon, John. Finnegans Wake: A Plot Summary. https://johngordonfinnegan.weebly.com
